goal: Test whether a score learned from daily SHARP CEA Br maps, added to the fixed 96 magnetic summaries, raises window precision at the project operating point (prior-year threshold at window recall 0.90, config/operating-point-v2.json).
acquisition_result: 32717 of 32717 requested maps were downloaded (12280512960 raw bytes); 20 maps contain no valid pixel and are treated as unavailable.

availability_rules.lag24: Primary. The rule frozen in config/sharp-maps-v1.json: a window at forecast time t uses the latest map of the same HARP with T_REC <= t - 24 h and no older than t - 48 h.
availability_rules.same: Sensitivity only. The latest map with T_REC <= t and no older than t - 24 h, which is the availability the 96 summaries already assume because they are computed from records of the same series up to t. No publication latency was measured, so a pass under this rule alone cannot justify anything beyond a latency measurement.
availability_rules.common: T_REC is a TAI stamp read as UTC, which places each map about 37 s later than it was recorded. A window without such a map has map_available = 0 and missing age and score; absence is never encoded as a quiet region.

cnn.input: 128 x 256 float map, divided by 500 G and clipped to [-6, 6]; scalars log(width/500), log(height/250), NaN fraction join the pooled features
cnn.architecture: four blocks of 3x3 convolution (16, 32, 64, 128 channels), batch normalisation, ReLU, 2x2 max pooling; global mean and max pooling; dropout 0.3; one linear output
cnn.label: 1 if the HARP has a positive training-role window with forecast time in [T_REC, T_REC + 48 h); maps with no training-role window in that span are not used for fitting
cnn.optimiser: Adam, learning rate 0.001, weight decay 0.0001, batch 64, 6 epochs, unweighted binary cross-entropy, no early stopping
cnn.augmentation: random left-right flip and random polarity sign flip
cnn.stacking: Three folds by HARP number modulo 3 inside the training role. A training-role HARP gets the score of the fold model that never saw it; calibration and evaluation HARPs get the mean logit of the three fold models. No calibration or evaluation label reaches the CNN.
cnn.reproducibility: Seeds are fixed, but the Apple MPS backend is not bitwise deterministic; the scores actually used are stored and hashed.

features.map_available_<rule>: 1 if a map satisfies the rule
features.map_age_hours_<rule>: t minus T_REC of that map
features.cnn_logit_<rule>: stacked CNN logit of that map

candidates.definition: Frozen baseline probabilities with the prior-year threshold at recall 0.90. No refit.
Refit of the unchanged walk-forward-v1 recipes on 96 summaries plus map_available_lag24 and map_age_hours_lag24. Isolates refitting and availability from image content.
Sensitivity counterpart of flag_lag24 under the same rule.
Sensitivity counterpart of image_lag24 under the same rule.

training: Annual folds of helio24.walk_forward.annual_fold; fold audits must equal the frozen baseline. Models, hyperparameters, calibration and the 0.45/0.55 weight are those of config/walk-forward-v1.json. Thresholds come from calibration-year probabilities at window recall 0.90 and are hashed before any evaluation label is read.

acceptance.all_year_primary: per_year_primary holds in all six years for image_lag24
acceptance.attribution: A pass of an image candidate that its flag counterpart does not share is attributed to image content.
also_reported: average precision of the CNN score alone on covered evaluation windows
acceptance.result_meaning: A pass justifies only a separate prospective protocol. It never changes alerts, thresholds or models.

limits: One map per day at a fixed 128 x 256 shape; a small CNN with one frozen recipe; definitive-series maps, not near-real-time ones; already inspected years, so adaptive development and not an independent test. A negative result bounds this recipe and cadence, not every image model.
prohibitions: No evaluation labels in any feature, fit or threshold
No architecture, feature or hyperparameter change after results
No map with T_REC after the rule's cutoff
